title: bihai mariae
intro: Bihai mariae, commonly known as Marygold or Calendula officinalis, is a flowering plant in the daisy family native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bihai mariae include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, triterpene saponins, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
